seo.title: B2B Wholesale Portal Development | CloudTopia
seo.description: Build a B2B wholesale portal with custom pricing, bulk ordering, and account terms — owned by you. Free consultation & demo.

hero.subtitle: A B2B ordering portal with per-account pricing, bulk and re-order flows, quotes, and credit terms — so wholesale buyers order with ease.

items.title: Per-account pricing
items.description: Custom price lists, tiers, and discounts per customer.

items.title: Bulk & re-order
items.description: Fast bulk ordering and one-click re-orders for regulars.

items.title: Quotes & terms
items.description: Quote requests, approvals, and credit/payment terms.

items.title: You own everything
items.description: The store/accounts, code, data, and documentation stay with you — no lock-in.

faqs.question: Can each client see their own pricing?
faqs.answer: Yes — every B2B account logs in to its own catalog, negotiated pricing, and terms, controlled from your admin.

faqs.question: Does it support quotes and credit terms?
faqs.answer: Yes — buyers can request quotes and order on agreed credit terms, with approvals routed to your team.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
